integrity: Necessity follows from the source coefficient identities and the exact two-coefficient Schwarz constraint. Sufficiency is constructive: an arbitrary admissible Schwarz coefficient pair is realized by a degree-at-most-two Schur function, then integrated through the source differential relation; positive real part of the dominant prevents zeros and produces an actual class member. The extremizer transition is then read from the exact disk fibers.
scientific_limitations: The exact coefficient-body sufficiency is proved for the natural range 1<k<k0 in which the cited source establishes a positive-real dominant for g/(zg'). Only the second and third Taylor coefficients are classified, and no claim is made beyond k0 or for higher-dimensional coefficient bodies.
title: Exact second–third coefficient body and extremizer bifurcation in the Mocanu–Robertson class
